reason: Both correctly identify normal heat-pump behaviour and avoid unsupported fault or part claims, but Conversation 2 explains why (lower temperature, fridge-in-reverse, 2–4 h cycles) in a way that addresses the homeowner's stated ignorance of how heat pump dryers differ, and sets a sensible escalation boundary ('if clothes are still damp with clean filters').
